jonahRoute.text:
Connection to Matthew 12:40
Later canonical reception
Textual direction: Jonah 1:17 → Matthew 12:40. This route can be followed from either passage.
Open related passage: Matthew 12:40
Matthew 12:40 explicitly compares Jonah’s narrated three days and nights in the fish with the Son of Man’s time in the heart of the earth. Jonah 1:17 is standard English numbering for MT/LXX Jonah 2:1.

Current passage: Nahum 3:8-9

What to notice
Does Nahum 3:8–9 compare Nineveh with No-Amon?

In the Masoretic text, Nineveh is compared with No-Amon. One scholar argues that Greek and Qumran readings may preserve an earlier description of Nineveh alone.

That changes how the names in Nahum 3:8–9 fit together. It is a textual reconstruction, not archaeological confirmation.

This is a proposed historical explanation, not an established fact. The reconstruction is disputed; the article's account of the Qumran reading was checked, but no manuscript image or critical edition was inspected.

Current passage: Proverbs 15:25

What to notice
Why do Hebrew and Greek Proverbs arrange 15:25–16:9 differently?

Hebrew and Greek versions arrange part of Proverbs 15:25–16:9 differently. Macchi documents the differences and proposes that an editor moved several lines and added 16:1–3.

The comparison shows that this wisdom passage circulated in more than one textual arrangement. The proposed editing is not directly dated.

Scholars may explain the differences in other ways. 4QProvb preserves only part of the passage; no fragment image or critical edition was inspected.
